spatialloop.create.radius.value: %s chunks (%s blocks), max view distance %s chunks
spatialloop.create.radius.tooltip: 0 = off. When enabled, east meets west and south meets north with no boundary. View distance limit = radius - 14: vanilla keeps 13 chunks of generation dependencies outside the ticket area, so only a view distance that stays 13 chunks short of the radius avoids two writable copies of the same space.
